summary: Challis National Forest cabin site with an alidade, developed in 1935 and abandoned in the 1950s; listed as gone, and no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Marked R.I.P. on firelookout.com; no source describes what remains on the site

events.note: Camp with an alidade, dated c.1930 on Rex's page, before the cabin
Sources say the 1950's (1950s); 1950 marks the decade, not a dated event

evidence.supports: Developed 1935 with a cabin and alidade; abandoned in the 1950s
evidence.quote: Developed in 1935, the site had a cabin and alidade. It was abandoned in the 1950's.
We don't yet have a documented staffing history for this lookout.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Rex's page dates a camp with an alidade to c.1930 and the cabin to 1935; firelookout.com dates development to 1935. Both are kept: 1935 is the built date for the cabin, with c.1930 as an earlier camp.

notes_for_editor: County conflict left open: firelookout.com says Lemhi County (30 miles southeast of Stanley); Rex's page and the record say Custer. Record unchanged. Rex's page also lists a separate Sheep Mountain lookout (Challis NF 15N-12E-33) that is a different site; do not merge them. No fire or staffing history in any source read. Two searches found nothing describing the site today.
